svg.text: left_motorPololu 30:1 Metal Gearmotor 37Dx68L 12 V with 64 CPR encoder
right_motorPololu 30:1 Metal Gearmotor 37Dx68L 12 V with 64 CPR encoder
motor_driver_1Cytron MDD10A dual-channel 10 A DC motor driver
regulator_5vPololu D36V50F5 5 V 5.5 A step-down regulator
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
Inline ATM mini blade fuse holder
VBAT 11.1 V from SW1: load 3.366 A typical, 13.503 A peak; source 35 A cont, 70 A peak; fuse 7.5 A
5V 5 V from U4: load 1.03 A typical, 5 A peak; source 5.5 A cont, 8 A peak
Fuses: F1 7.5 A (everything on VBAT), F2 2 A (branch regulator_5v). Branch fuses sit inline in the lead they protect.
Lever splices (star_ground, splice_vbat) are junctions of their nets.
Same net label or power symbol = same conductor. X = pin not connected.
